name: Normalcy and Deviance: Philosophical Approaches to Sexuality
description: What is sexuality? Is it simply a function of what kind of sex we have and with whom? Why do we seem to find sex so fascinating, constantly debating people’s sexual habits and desires and speculating on what they mean ? Somehow our sexual identities seem to be the most important thing about us, much more important than what we eat, what country we grew up in, or our political beliefs. Moreover, there is an anxiety that we get it right, that we cultivate the right desires, the right relationships, the right performance of gender
